description.en: Objective questions on main and subordinate clauses (noun, adjective, adverb clauses) for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে main আৰু subordinate clause (noun, adjective, adverb clause)ৰ ওপৰত গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰশ্ন।

q.en: A group of words that contains a subject and a finite verb and forms part of a sentence is a ___.
q.as: যি শব্দসমষ্টিত subject আৰু finite verb থাকে আৰু বাক্যৰ অংশ হয় তাক ___ বোলে।

a.en: A clause has its own subject and verb.
a.as: Clause ৰ নিজস্ব subject আৰু verb থাকে।

q.en: A clause that can stand alone as a complete sentence is called the ___ clause.
q.as: যি clause অকলে থিয় হৈ সম্পূৰ্ণ বাক্য হ'ব পাৰে তাক ___ clause বোলে।

a.en: A main (independent) clause makes complete sense by itself.
a.as: Main (independent) clause অকলে সম্পূৰ্ণ অৰ্থ দিয়ে।

q.en: A clause that cannot stand alone and depends on the main clause is a ___ clause.
q.as: যি clause অকলে থিয় হ'ব নোৱাৰে আৰু main clause ৰ ওপৰত নিৰ্ভৰ কৰে তাক ___ clause বোলে।

a.en: A subordinate clause depends on the main clause for its meaning.
a.as: Subordinate clause অৰ্থৰ বাবে main clause ৰ ওপৰত নিৰ্ভৰশীল।

q.en: Identify the main clause: 'I know that he is honest.'
q.as: Main clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'I know that he is honest.'

a.en: 'I know' can stand alone and carries the main idea.
a.as: 'I know' অকলে থিয় হ'ব পাৰে আৰু মূল ভাৱ বহন কৰে।

q.en: Identify the subordinate clause: 'I know that he is honest.'
q.as: Subordinate clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'I know that he is honest.'

a.en: 'That he is honest' cannot stand alone; it is the object of 'know'.
a.as: 'That he is honest' অকলে থিয় নহয়; ই 'know' ৰ কৰ্ম।

q.en: Identify the main clause: 'He returned home before it rained.'
q.as: Main clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'He returned home before it rained.'

a.en: 'He returned home' makes complete sense by itself.
a.as: 'He returned home' অকলে সম্পূৰ্ণ অৰ্থ দিয়ে।

q.en: Which of the following contains a noun clause?
q.as: তলৰ কোন বাক্যত noun clause আছে?

options.en: I know that he is honest.
options.as: I know that he is honest.

options.en: This is the book that I bought.
options.as: This is the book that I bought.

options.en: The boy who came is my friend.
options.as: The boy who came is my friend.

a.en: 'That he is honest' works as the object of 'know' (a noun clause).
a.as: 'That he is honest'  noun clause হিচাপে 'know' ৰ কৰ্ম।

q.en: A clause that works as the subject or object of a verb is a ___ clause.
q.as: যি clause  verb ৰ subject বা object হিচাপে কাম কৰে তাক ___ clause বোলে।

a.en: A noun clause does the work of a noun.
a.as: Noun clause  noun ৰ দৰে কাম কৰে।

q.en: 'That he is honest' in 'I know that he is honest' is a ___ clause.
q.as: 'I know that he is honest' বাক্যটোত 'that he is honest' এটা ___ clause।

a.en: It is the object of the verb 'know'.

q.en: A clause that qualifies (describes) a noun or pronoun is an ___ clause.
q.as: যি clause  noun বা pronoun ৰ বিশেষণ কৰে তাক ___ clause বোলে।

a.en: An adjective clause is also called a relative clause.
a.as: Adjective clause ক relative clause ও বোলে।

q.en: Identify the adjective clause: 'The boy who stood first is my friend.'
q.as: Adjective clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'The boy who stood first is my friend.'

a.en: The clause qualifies the noun 'boy'.
a.as: ই clause টোৱে 'boy' বিশেষ্যৰ বিশেষণ কৰিছে।

q.en: 'Who stood first' in the above sentence is a ___ clause.
q.as: ওপৰৰ বাক্যটোত 'who stood first' এটা ___ clause।

a.en: It is introduced by the relative pronoun 'who'.
a.as: ই relative pronoun 'who' ৰে আৰম্ভ হৈছে।

q.en: A clause that modifies a verb, an adjective or another adverb is an ___ clause.
q.as: যি clause  verb, adjective বা আন adverb ৰ modification কৰে তাক ___ clause বোলে।

a.en: An adverb clause does the work of an adverb.
a.as: Adverb clause  adverb ৰ দৰে কাম কৰে।

q.en: Identify the adverb clause: 'He works hard so that he may pass.'
q.as: Adverb clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'He works hard so that he may pass.'

a.en: The clause shows the purpose of working hard.
a.as: clause টোৱে কঠোৰ পৰিশ্ৰমৰ উদ্দেশ্য দেখুৱাইছে।

q.en: The clause 'so that he may pass' shows ___.
q.as: 'so that he may pass' clause টোৱে ___ প্ৰকাশ কৰে।

a.en: 'So that' introduces an adverb clause of purpose.
a.as: 'So that' উদ্দেশ্যবোধক adverb clause ৰ সূচনা কৰে।

q.en: In 'As he was ill, he did not come', the clause 'as he was ill' is an adverb clause of ___.
q.as: 'As he was ill, he did not come' বাক্যটোত 'as he was ill' clause টো ___ ৰ adverb clause।

a.en: 'As' (meaning because) shows the reason.

q.en: Identify the adverb clause of time: 'When the rain stopped, we went out.'
q.as: সময়বোধক adverb clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'When the rain stopped, we went out.'

a.en: 'When' shows the time of the action.

q.en: Which sentence contains an adverb clause of place?
q.as: তলৰ কোন বাক্যত স্থানবোধক adverb clause আছে?

options.en: I will go where you go.
options.as: I will go where you go.

options.en: I will go after you come.
options.as: I will go after you come.

options.en: I will go because you go.
options.as: I will go because you go.

options.en: If you go, I will go.
options.as: If you go, I will go.

a.en: 'Where you go' shows the place of going.

q.en: Identify the adverb clause of condition: 'If you work hard, you will succeed.'
q.as: শর্তবোধক adverb clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'If you work hard, you will succeed.'

a.en: 'If' introduces a condition.

q.en: Identify the adverb clause of result: 'He is so weak that he cannot walk.'
q.as: ফলবোধক adverb clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'He is so weak that he cannot walk.'

a.en: 'So...that' expresses result/consequence.

q.en: Which sentence contains an adverb clause of comparison?
q.as: তলৰ কোন বাক্যত তুলনাবোধক adverb clause আছে?

options.en: She is not as clever as her sister.
options.as: She is not as clever as her sister.

options.en: She will come when she can.
options.as: She will come when she can.

options.en: He ran so fast that he won.
options.as: He ran so fast that he won.

options.en: He failed because he was careless.
options.as: He failed because he was careless.

a.en: 'As...as' shows comparison.

q.en: Identify the adverb clause of concession: 'Although he is poor, he is honest.'
q.as: স্বীকৃতিবোধক (concession) adverb clause চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'Although he is poor, he is honest.'

a.en: 'Although' introduces a clause of concession (contrast).

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ he will come is doubtful.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: '___ he will come is doubtful.'

a.en: Here the noun clause is the subject: 'That he will come'.
a.as: ইয়াত noun clause টো subject: 'That he will come'।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The news ___ he has passed is true.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'The news ___ he has passed is true.'

a.en: The noun clause is in apposition to 'the news'.
a.as: noun clause টো 'the news' ৰ apposition ৰূপে আছে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I doubt ___ he will come.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'I doubt ___ he will come.'

a.en: After 'doubt' (in doubt), 'whether/if' is used.

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Tell me ___ you want.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'Tell me ___ you want.'

a.en: 'What you want' is the object of 'tell'.

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The man ___ helped me was my uncle.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'The man ___ helped me was my uncle.'

a.en: 'Who' is the subject of the adjective clause.

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The man ___ I met yesterday is a doctor.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'The man ___ I met yesterday is a doctor.'

a.en: 'Whom' is the object of 'met'.

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The boy ___ father died is poor.'
q.as: শূন্যস্থান পূৰণ কৰক: 'The boy ___ father died is poor.'

a.en: 'Whose' shows possession.

q.en: Combine using an adjective clause: 'I have a friend. He lives in Guwahati.'
q.as: Adjective clause  ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি বাক্য দুটা যুক্ত কৰক: 'I have a friend. He lives in Guwahati.'

options.en: I have a friend who lives in Guwahati.
options.as: I have a friend who lives in Guwahati.

options.en: I have a friend and he lives in Guwahati.
options.as: I have a friend and he lives in Guwahati.

options.en: I have a friend living in Guwahati and I have him.
options.as: I have a friend living in Guwahati and I have him.

options.en: I have a friend; he lives in Guwahati.
options.as: I have a friend; he lives in Guwahati.

a.en: The pronoun 'he' is replaced by the relative 'who'.

q.en: Combine using a relative clause: 'This is the house. Rabindranath was born here.'
q.as: Relative clause  ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি বাক্য দুটা যুক্ত কৰক: 'This is the house. Rabindranath was born here.'

options.en: This is the house where Rabindranath was born.
options.as: This is the house where Rabindranath was born.

options.en: This is the house who Rabindranath was born.
options.as: This is the house who Rabindranath was born.

options.en: This is the house when Rabindranath was born.
options.as: This is the house when Rabindranath was born.

options.en: This is the house whose Rabindranath was born.
options.as: This is the house whose Rabindranath was born.

a.en: The relative adverb 'where' joins the clauses.
a.as: relative adverb 'where'  ৰে clause দুটা যুক্ত হয়।

q.en: 'Where I was born' in 'This is the house where I was born' is a/an ___ clause.
q.as: 'This is the house where I was born' বাক্যটোত 'where I was born' এটা ___ clause।

a.en: It qualifies the noun 'house'.

q.en: 'That she was ill' in 'She said that she was ill' is a ___ clause.
q.as: 'She said that she was ill' বাক্যটোত 'that she was ill' এটা ___ clause।

a.en: It is the object of the verb 'said'.

q.en: 'Where he lives' in 'I don't know where he lives' is a ___ clause.
q.as: 'I don't know where he lives' বাক্যটোত 'where he lives' এটা ___ clause।

a.en: It is the object of 'know' (indirect question).

q.en: A sentence having one main clause and one or more subordinate clauses is a ___ sentence.
q.as: এটা main clause আৰু এটা বা বেছি subordinate clause থকা বাক্য এটা ___ বাক্য।

a.en: Complex sentences contain subordinate clauses.

q.en: Two or more main clauses joined by 'and', 'but' or 'or' make a ___ sentence.
q.as: 'and', 'but' বা 'or'  ৰে যুক্ত দুটা বা বেছি main clause এটা ___ বাক্য গঠন কৰে।

a.en: Coordinating conjunctions make compound sentences.
a.as: Coordinating conjunction  য়ে compound sentence গঠন কৰে।

q.en: Combine using 'though': 'He is poor. He is happy.'
q.as: 'though' ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি যুক্ত কৰক: 'He is poor. He is happy.'

options.en: Though he is poor, he is happy.
options.as: Though he is poor, he is happy.

options.en: Though he is happy, he is poor.
options.as: Though he is happy, he is poor.

options.en: He is poor though he is happy.
options.as: He is poor though he is happy.

options.en: Though he is poor and he is happy.
options.as: Though he is poor and he is happy.

a.en: 'Though' joins them as an adverb clause of concession.
a.as: 'though'  য়ে বিৰোধ বুজোৱা adverb clause ৰূপে যুক্ত কৰে।

q.en: Combine using 'because': 'He failed. He was careless.'
q.as: 'because' ব্যৱহাৰ কৰি যুক্ত কৰক: 'He failed. He was careless.'

options.en: He failed because he was careless.
options.as: He failed because he was careless.

options.en: He was careless because he failed.
options.as: He was careless because he failed.

options.en: Because he failed he was careless.
options.as: Because he failed he was careless.

options.en: He failed and he was careless.
options.as: He failed and he was careless.

a.en: 'Because' shows the reason for his failure.

q.en: Identify the kind of sentence: 'I called him but he did not come.'
q.as: বাক্যটোৰ প্ৰকাৰ চিনাক্ত কৰক: 'I called him but he did not come.'

a.en: Two main clauses are joined by 'but'.
a.as: 'but'  ৰে দুটা main clause যুক্ত হৈছে।

q.en: Name the clause: 'that he is honest' in 'The truth is that he is honest.'
q.as: Clause টোৰ নাম লিখক: 'The truth is that he is honest.' বাক্যটোত 'that he is honest'।

a.en: A noun clause (it is the complement of the verb 'is').

q.en: 'When he came' in 'I was sleeping when he came' is an adverb clause of ___.
q.as: 'I was sleeping when he came' বাক্যটোত 'when he came' এটা ___ ৰ adverb clause।

a.en: Time (it shows when the action happened).
